latest_features: The injector now supports C7_WORLD_PROXY_URL and world_proxy_helper_url.txt so older Bedrock clients can pin a legacy proxy-helper download instead of being forced onto the latest incompatible helper
The proxy helper URL override is cached by source URL, so repeated launches keep the pinned helper until you change the override instead of redownloading every time
The injector still honors C7_WORLD_PROXY_EXE before the managed helper cache for fully local custom helper builds
Minimap pins remain north-up and ShulkMod2 keeps the admin and vip visibility fallback introduced in the previous release
